{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsor nodules''' were tiny [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] used on small [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Deeve]] had a [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[REM-02]], which was fitted with repulsor nodules along its bottom surface to allow it to descend into [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]] safely.
